name: RANJANA SHARAN SINHA

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Ranjana Sharan Sinha is a poet, literary critic and retired professor of English associated with Nagpur. Her writing includes the poetry collections Scents and Shadows and The Purple Jacaranda and Other Poems, alongside short fiction and criticism. Purnea University’s postgraduate English syllabus lists her poems “She is gone forever” and “The Silent shore”.

In “The Earth and the Sky”, an airplane journey becomes a movement between wonder and belonging. Colour-filled clouds briefly lighten the weight of age, while trees, rain, breeze and ocean draw the speaker back towards earth. The closing bird returning to its nest gives that return an intimate, bodily shape.
